package autobackup // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/autobackup"

func CheckDatabase(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, limit int64) error

func CopyPrivate(ctx context.Context, source, destination string, limit int64) (err error)

func Create(ctx context.Context, c Config, snapshot Snapshot) (output string, err error)

type Config struct {
	Name         string
	Directory    string
	Interval     time.Duration
	Keep         int
	MaxBytes     int64
	CopyMaxBytes int64
}

func Load(name, dataDir string, lookup func(string) string) (Config, error)

func (c Config) Validate() error

type Runner struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func New(c Config, snapshot Snapshot, logger *slog.Logger) (*Runner, error)

func (r *Runner) Run(ctx context.Context)

func (r *Runner) Status() Status

type Snapshot func(ctx context.Context, destination string, limit int64) error

type Status struct {
	Enabled      bool
	Directory    string
	Interval     time.Duration
	Keep         int
	MaxBytes     int64
	CopyMaxBytes int64
	Running      bool
	LastAttempt  time.Time
	LastSuccess  time.Time
	LastError    string
	NextAttempt  time.Time
}

func (s Status) ArchiveCap() string

func (s Status) CopyCap() string
